A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TopoHR work, and their text, equations, tables, and figures are readable. v1 contains supplementary Sections A–E; v2 ends after the references. This is an identifiable omission from the supplied PDF, not an extraction gap.

before.justification: v1 reports original OpenLane-V2 evaluations and ablations in Tables 1–8, plus qualitative topology and detection results.

after.justification: v2 retains original TopoHR benchmark results and ablations in Tables 1–5 and qualitative topology predictions in Figure 4.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same cyclic interaction, hierarchical decoder, discrete distance transform masks, topology reasoning branches, and adaptive topological loss. Removing supplementary evaluations does not change the proposed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate centerline detection, traffic-element detection, and topology reasoning on OpenLane-V2 subsets A and B. The omitted supplement uses these same tasks and validation data; no distinct dataset or separately defined test scenario disappears.

E2.justification: v2 removes Table 6's efficiency comparison against six-layer TopoLogic and the twelve-layer TopoLogic* variant. Comparator membership in the retained benchmark Tables 1–2 is unchanged, including the standard TopoLogic comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported evaluation loses Table 6's six-versus-twelve-layer capacity control and batch-size-one FPS comparison. Settings for retained experiments, including preprocessing, metrics, query counts, and training budgets, remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v2 removes the computational-cost and model-capacity analysis, both subset-B component-ablation suites, and additional topology and driving-scene case studies in supplementary Sections A–D, Tables 6–8, and Figures 5–7. Subset-A ablations and Figure 4 remain, but the supplementary analyses are substantially reduced.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, variability estimates, or significance tests. The removed supplementary tables also report point estimates without uncertainty.

E6.justification: Main Tables 1–5 are numerically unchanged, but substantial supplementary results disappear. Examples include twelve-layer TopoLogic's 30.2 DETl, 24.8 TOPll, and 10.8 FPS in Table 6, and subset-B representation-ablation results progressing from 25.9/21.1 to 31.8/30.2 DETl/TOPll in Table 7. Additional qualitative findings in Figures 5–7 are also removed.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, relation formulations, and Equations (1)–(5) are unchanged. The omitted supplement contains empirical analyses and discussion, without additional theoretical derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about cyclic enhancement, hierarchical representations, point-to-instance reasoning, and benchmark performance. These claims are not narrowed despite removal of supplementary support.

C2.justification: v2 omits Appendix A's interpretation attributing gains to architectural design rather than model size. It also removes Appendix E's specific limitations concerning traffic-element associations under occlusion, complex scenes, and diverse geometry, together with the proposed future direction. Main-text mechanism interpretations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Table 6's per-variant model-size and decoder-depth information and explicit batch size for timing are lost. Main implementation details, optimizer settings, training hardware, input processing, reported 12.6 FPS, and the code-release statement remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, novelty positioning, and all 35 referenced works remain unchanged. The changed page back-reference for MapTR is a pagination update.

P1.justification: v2 adds Bo Song to the author list, revises affiliations and correspondence information, and removes the supplementary section structure. The retained main narrative preserves its wording and section order, with limited text reflow.

P2.justification: v2 removes three supplementary tables and three figures, including the efficiency comparison, subset-B ablation displays, topology heatmaps, and multiscene qualitative panels. Main Tables 1–5 and Figures 1–4 retain their content and design, with minor opening-page layout shifts.

improvement.justification: The main method and benchmark findings remain intact, but v2 removes the explicit model-capacity control, comparative efficiency analysis, all subset-B component ablations, and concrete limitations. This substantially weakens assessment of the gains' causes, computational tradeoffs, and applicability without replacement evidence. Section 4.2 also continues to direct readers to supplementary material absent from the supplied v2.
